item.title: Show HN: Curia – Personal Radio and AI Podcasts
item.summary: hi everyone I've made this personalised audio app called Curia, that turns articles & links, into audio shows. You can customize the show format, to fit different moments of the day. Would love for people to try out and share feedback. My long term vision is to make the personal media company, where user is co-author or co-programmer of their feed, shifting the role away from the algorithm that works in favour of the platform and not the user.
